text: Justin LeBlanc is the musician represented by this private-event booking demo.
Justin's current site presents private-event music for Houston and beyond.
The demo process is inquiry, consultation plus a tentative hold, then operator confirmation after an agreed quote.
All prices in this demo are editable examples and are not Justin's published or approved rates.

Demo consultation slots are 20 minutes, Monday through Friday from 10:00 to 16:00 Central Time (America/Chicago), with no minimum advance notice for future available times and with actual free/busy checks.
All demo booking, consultation, and event times default to Houston Central Time (America/Chicago) and follow daylight-saving transitions when a caller or visitor does not specify a time zone.
A tentative hold is not a confirmed performance. Only an authenticated operator can confirm it after the consultation and an agreed quote.

Each morning at 08:00 Houston Central Time (America/Chicago), completed confirmed calendar performances are assumed played and invoiced automatically using the agreed quote. No performance-confirmation email reply is required. The invoice goes to the billing contact with the performer BCC'd. Missing or mismatched billing details require operator review; tentative holds, cancelled events, and consultations are not invoiced.
Actual repertoire, packages, rates, deposits, cancellation terms, production inclusions, and travel policy require Justin's approval.
